verdict.rationale: Gladia is an API product, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question. However, a probe found that every common OpenAPI/Swagger path on docs.gladia.io returns 404, and no doc in the pack mentions a machine-readable API spec. The llms.txt index, markdown docs, CLI, and MCP server are adjacent features and earn no credit; confidence is medium because the probe only checked standard candidate paths.
